title: PAS 99 Integrated Management System Readiness Checklist
subtitle: A practical checklist for integrating ISO 9001, 14001, 45001 and 22000 into one common framework
intro: PAS 99 is BSI's specification for integrating two or more management system standards into one common framework, built around the shared high-level structure modern ISO standards already have. This checklist covers what integration actually requires, standard by standard and clause by clause.

sections.title: Scope & Common Structure
items: List every management system standard currently certified or targeted for integration
Confirm each standard's clause structure against PAS 99's common framework
Identify which clauses are already genuinely shared versus duplicated across standards
Define the scope of the integrated system — sites, business units, processes covered

sections.title: Policy & Objectives
items: Replace separate policies per standard with one integrated policy statement
Set integrated objectives that address requirements from every standard in scope
Confirm leadership commitment covers the integrated system, not one certificate at a time
Communicate the integrated policy and objectives to all affected roles

sections.title: Document Control
items: Identify procedures that currently exist once per standard and consolidate where genuinely shared
Establish one document control and version management process across the integrated system
Remove duplicate or conflicting versions of the same procedure held under different standards
Confirm document access reflects the integrated structure, not the old per-standard silos

sections.title: Risk & Planning
items: Assess risks and opportunities across the integrated scope, not per standard
Confirm legal and other requirements are tracked once across all applicable standards
Plan changes to the management system with impact assessed across every integrated standard
Align planning cycles so all standards are considered together, not on separate timelines

sections.title: Operational Control
items: Map operational controls that serve more than one standard and run them as one process
Confirm competence, training and awareness requirements are addressed once across the integrated scope
Standardise supplier and outsourced-process controls across every relevant standard
Ensure emergency preparedness and change management cover the full integrated scope

sections.title: Consolidated Audit Programme
items: Build one internal audit programme covering every certified standard in the integration
Confirm auditor competence spans the standards being audited together, or assign appropriately
Audit shared processes once against the combined requirements, not once per standard
Track findings against the integrated system, with a clear line back to the specific standard(s) affected

sections.title: Management Review & Improvement
items: Hold one management review covering every standard in the integrated system
Report performance, nonconformances and audit results across all standards in a single dataset
Track corrective actions and continual improvement across the integrated system, not per silo
Confirm certification bodies' surveillance schedules are coordinated where possible
